evidence: The track starts at Raspberry Creek car park.
Follow the West Matukituki Track up the valley to Aspiring Hut.
At Pearl Flat, the West Matukituki Track connects with French Ridge Track and Liverpool Track.
Follow a steep and narrow track through the subalpine zone, then follow the gentle tussock slopes for about 1 km. The hut is at 1480 m, on flattish ground.

doubts: No packet entry is the Raspberry Creek car park (T12 is the creek, and there are no road-end features), so the start ref is null. The page gives only a one-way time to French Ridge Hut and does not say how hikers return; shape taken as one_way from DOC's 'one way' time. The second swing bridge over the Matukituki River has no entry. Rough Creek (just beyond Aspiring Hut) is on the way but its order relative to Cascade Creek is not stated, so it is omitted from via.
